The '''University of Yabol Opa''' was an [[University/Legends|establishment]] of education<ref name="CL" /> that existed by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="22 BBY" /> It encompassed the surface of the<ref name="CL" /> [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yabol Opa/Legends|Yabol Opa]]. By that [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Grand Warden/Legends|Grand Warden]]&mdash;and the absolute ruler&mdash;of the university was [[Solokin Sakellar/Legends|Solokin Sakellar]], who maintained a [[Coruscant Lodge of Solokin Sakellar/Legends|skyscraper lodge]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world that was situated in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="CL" />

==Behind the scenes==
The University of Yabol Opa was first mentioned in the [[2003]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'', authored by [[Simon Beecroft]].<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref>
